propositions: A new peer confirmation store must be created to persist evidence of managed link creation, recording link_id, direction, confirmed_pass, confirmed_at, and source for each unique (source_local_id, target_local_id, relation) triplet

The outbound link write seam requires three coordinated edits: dispatch_apply_phases gains a link_confirm callback invoked after successful set_relationship, dispatch_one forwards the callback, and apply_handlers builds it from BatchApplyContext

Confirmation records must be durably committed by staging both the file path in _rel_files AND its basename in _tracked_basenames, since _commit_binding_store_snapshot's idempotency guard drops changes if no tracked basename is staged
An unbound target (binding_store.get_local_id returns None) must skip recording entirely rather than persist a vendor key; missing link_id from set_relationship is valid and recorded as null
A link_confirm callback exception must be logged and swallowed without failing the outbound link or perturbing link count metrics
The store must survive compaction and gracefully degrade to empty (fail-open) on corrupt or absent peer_confirmations.json without raising an exception
